title: Servers
noContainers: No containers running (they appear a few seconds after the agent reports).
containerRemoveBody: This force-removes the container "{name}" on this server. Managed Tugra apps/databases are deleted from their own page — this is only for foreign containers. Type the name to confirm:
activityDesc: Every action taken on this server — who did what, newest first.
proxyDesc: The reverse proxy that routes traffic and manages SSL for apps with a domain.
proxyStopConfirm: Stop the proxy on this server? Every app and site it routes will go offline until it is started again.
proxyDynamicDesc: Operator-authored Traefik dynamic-config files (middlewares, TLS options, services). Each is written to the proxy and hot-reloaded. Reference a middleware from an app's domain by its name with the @file suffix (e.g. my-rate@file). An invalid file can take routes offline — the proxy logs show parse errors.
proxyDynamicEmpty: No custom dynamic configuration files yet.
proxyDynamicDeleteConfirm: Delete the dynamic configuration "{name}"? Any app referencing a middleware it defines will lose it on the next proxy reload.
selectAll: Select all servers on this page
empty: Connect your first server to start deploying apps and databases.
name: Server name (e.g. web-1)
installDesc: Run this command on your server (token embedded):
waiting: Waiting for the agent to connect…
bulkNamesHint: {n} server(s) will be created — each gets its own install command.
bulkCreatedHint: Run each command on its server (or copy all and run them in turn). Each server shows PENDING until its agent connects.
noCloudCredential: No Hetzner provider is set up for this team.
deleteServerDesc: Remove this server from Tugra. Its apps and metrics are dropped from the panel.
destroyVmHint: Tugra created this VM — leave this checked to delete it at the provider and stop billing. Uncheck to keep the VM running.
installPlainWarning: This command connects over plain ws:// (opted in with --hub-insecure). Commands from the hub are signed, but environment values and secrets travel readable on the network. Give the panel a domain (Settings → Panel domain) or use the IP install to get an encrypted address.
installPinnedNote: Encrypted: the agent connects over wss:// and trusts only this hub's own certificate — its fingerprint is in the command (--hub-pin). No domain needed.
troubleshootHint: Make sure you ran the command on the server, that it can reach this hub over the network (outbound WebSocket), and check the agent logs. The enroll token is valid for one hour — get a fresh command if it has expired.
noMetrics: No metrics yet — live stream starts when the agent connects.
capabilitiesDesc: What the hub is allowed to do on this server. Turn off anything you don't need — the terminal (interactive shell) is off by default on new servers.
cap_files_desc: Browse app volumes and download files through a sandboxed helper.
cap_files_write_desc: Also run a read-write helper (CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE and FOWNER, on one volume at a time) to upload, edit, rename, change permissions and delete. Requires Files.
cleanupDesc: Reclaims disk space by removing dangling image layers and build cache older than 7 days.
cleanupKeeps: Never deleted: app images (including rollback versions), stopped containers, networks and volumes. Unused anonymous volumes are removed only if “Also unused volumes” is on.
cleanupStateOffHint: Nothing is pruned on this server unless you press “Clean now”. Tick “Scheduled” and save to turn it back on.
cleanupRunsAtDisk: and whenever disk usage reaches {pct}% (at most once an hour)
cleanupDefaults: Defaults for every server: on, daily at 03:00, and also whenever disk usage reaches 80%.
cleanupCronHint: A cron expression (minute hour day month weekday) runs cleanup at a fixed time and overrides the hourly interval. Example: 0 3 * * * runs at 03:00 daily.
descriptionPlaceholder: Notes about this server (role, owner, location)…
timezoneHint: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Istanbul. Used for the cleanup cron schedule; applies on the next cleanup save or hub restart.
cleanupThresholdHint: On top of the schedule, a cleanup also runs when this server's disk usage reaches this percentage (checked every few minutes, at most once an hour). Leave empty for the schedule only.
diskUnavailable: Disk usage unavailable (the agent is offline or the capability is not granted).
cleanConfirmVolumes: This also removes unused named volumes, which can hold data not attached to a running container. Continue?
diskWarn: Disk is filling up. Reclaim space with a cleanup under Maintenance.
diskCrit: Disk is critically full. Run a cleanup under Maintenance now.
discoverDesc: Scan this server for containers not yet managed by Tugra and adopt them as apps.
discoverOwnNote: Tugra's own containers are never listed.
noForeignContainers: No unmanaged containers found on this server.
adoptDataWarning: Adopting only renames the container. A later redeploy from Tugra recreates it and will NOT carry over its volumes or bind-mounted data — set up matching volumes first if you need the data.
adoptImageWarning: Tugra will pull this image on the next redeploy, so make sure the server can reach it (locally-built images that were never pushed will fail).
networkDesc: Set a wildcard domain to serve apps at *.your-domain, override the magic suffix, or pin a public IP. Changes regenerate this server's magic domains (apply on next deploy).
dnsProviderHint: lego provider name — e.g. cloudflare, route53, digitalocean.
dnsCredsHint: One KEY=VALUE per line (e.g. CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=…). Stored encrypted; use a least-privilege, zone-scoped token. Leave blank to keep the current credentials.
tunnelDesc: Expose this server's apps to the internet with no public IP and no port-forwarding — Tugra runs cloudflared and routes traffic through Cloudflare. Enable it per app from each app's Expose settings.
tunnelCertWarn: This server's certificate mode isn't Plain HTTP. Cloudflare terminates TLS at its edge for tunnel traffic, so set HTTPS certificates to Plain HTTP to avoid a redirect loop while the tunnel is active.
tunnelApiTokenHint: Create a token with Zone:DNS Edit, Zone:Zone Read and Account:Cloudflare Tunnel Edit. Stored encrypted; never a Global API Key.
tunnelWildcardHint: Where apps are served, e.g. apps.example.com. Defaults to the zone. A wildcard CNAME is created for it.
tunnelDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect the Cloudflare Tunnel? This stops cloudflared, deletes the tunnel and its wildcard DNS record. Apps will no longer be reachable through it.
tunnelNotConfigured: No Cloudflare Tunnel is configured for this server.
tunnelSetupFailed: Couldn't connect the tunnel. Check the API token, account ID and zone.

gpus.title: Detected GPUs
gpus.refreshNeedsWrite: You need server-ops permission to re-run GPU detection
gpus.driverMissing: NVIDIA GPU found but no driver loaded
gpus.runtimeMissing: Docker has no NVIDIA runtime registered. GPU containers may still work if the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed.
gpus.nonNvidia: Docker's --gpus flag is NVIDIA-only, so these GPUs can't be handed to containers here.
gpus.busy: Another detection is already running on this server; showing the last result.
gpus.errForbidden: GPU detection needs the 'bulk' capability and server-ops permission

acmeDns.label: Use a team DNS credential
acmeDns.noCredentials: This team has no DNS credentials yet. Add one under DNS credentials.
acmeDns.coverageVerified: Verified {date}. Make sure its token covers every zone this server serves certificates for.
acmeDns.coverageUnverified: Not verified yet. Test the credential first, and make sure its token covers every zone this server serves.
acmeDns.readOnly: This credential is read-only, so it cannot create the DNS-01 challenge records.
acmeDns.tokenCopied: The token is copied to this server when you save. If you rotate the credential later, the server keeps the old token until you re-apply it.
acmeDns.reapplyHint: Save first to switch credentials; re-apply only refreshes the one already in use.

teamMoveDesc: Choose which team owns this server.
teamMoveNoTargets: You have no other team to move this server to.
teamMoveSafe: The agent stays connected and nothing is reinstalled.
teamMoveBlocked: This server still has resources that belong to {team}. Move or remove them first.
teamMoveBlockedRetry: Something new appeared on this server. Move or remove it first.
teamMoveMoreKeeps: Settings, metrics, traffic and history stay with the server.
teamMoveMoreMonitor: Its default disk monitor moves with it.
teamMoveDetachCloud: The cloud provider link ({name}) is removed. Link a provider key of the new team to restore power and rescue actions.
teamMoveDetachCloudUnnamed: The cloud provider link is removed. Link a provider key of the new team to restore power and rescue actions.
teamMoveDetachDns: The DNS credential link ({name}) is cleared.
teamMoveDetachDnsUnnamed: The DNS credential link is cleared.
teamMoveDetachDnsSecret: The copied DNS token is deleted and wildcard certificates switch to HTTP. Add a DNS credential of the new team to restore them.
teamMoveDetachChannels: Alerts from its default disk monitor stop going to the old team's channels.
teamMoveOpenShells: Open terminals on this server are closed.
teamMoveBlocker_build_server: Apps that build on this server
teamMoveBlocker_app_move: App moves in progress or awaiting cleanup
teamMoveBlocker_reboot: A reboot in progress or scheduled
quickTerminalOff: Terminal is off for this server

bulkCaps.title: Access for {n} selected
bulkCaps.hint: Turn opt-in features on or off. Everything below is listed before you confirm.
bulkCaps.desc_terminal: Opens a root shell on the server.
bulkCaps.desc_files_write: Upload, edit and delete app files. Needs Files.
bulkCaps.desc_swarm: Let the server join a Docker Swarm.

teamMoveBulk.title: Move {n} servers to another team
teamMoveBulk.hint: Each server is checked on its own. Servers that still hold the old team's apps or databases stay where they are.
teamMoveBulk.status_blocked: Stays: old team's resources on it

nameHint: Leave it blank and the server's own hostname is used. You can rename it later.
ipUnknownHint: Not detected. Enter it under Network.
ipPinFailed: Could not set the main address.
agentFleetBehind: {n}/{total} agents are on an older version
agentFleetAuto: They are updating one by one.
agentFleetWaitingHub: The hub updates first, then the agents follow.
agentFleetManual: Update them all in one click.
agentFleetNone: Nothing could be updated right now.
agentFleetHubBehind: Update the hub first. Agents never run ahead of it.
